'''Elnore Mandragoran''' is the daughter of [[Lan Mandragoran]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] in Nynaeve's [[Accepted]] test.{{ref/book|2|23}}

==Activities==
She is named for her late [[Elnore al'Meara|maternal grandmother]], and has a brother named [[Maric Mandragoran|Maric]].

Lan tells Nynaeve that Elnore has started talking to boys, and questioning [[Sharina Melloy|Sharina]] Sedai on when she will be old enough to go to the [[White Tower]].{{ref/book|2|23}}
